topic.title: After a CS2 Update: Check Status Before Relaunching

evidence.heading: T2-07 editorial contract
evidence.excerpt: Promote a stop-and-check workflow after updates without stating current compatibility or giving anti-cheat evasion steps.

evidence.heading: Product mapping
evidence.excerpt: CS2 content maps to cluster.center, with qualified and time-bounded product claims.

evidence.heading: Update sensitivity
evidence.excerpt: Compatibility and status can change, so readers should rely on current first-party support information rather than stale articles.
